difficultyRationale: Distinguishes date-adjustment methods that clamp invalid dates from methods that reject an invalid requested day.
explanation: April has only 30 days. `withDayOfMonth` validates the requested day for the resulting year/month and throws `DateTimeException` when it is invalid.

options.explanation: withDayOfMonth does not clamp an explicitly requested invalid day.
The operation does not overflow an invalid day into the next month.

options.text: It returns the original date unchanged.
options.explanation: An invalid requested day is reported rather than ignored.
